room_description: An ancient stone temple or tomb with lion statues, pedestals, and glowing blue energy.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot of the stone temple.
Finding a stone artifact on a pedestal with an eagle carving.
Inspecting the left lion statue with glowing green eyes.
Finding a hammer on the floor near a pillar.
Using the hammer to break a clay pot to find a golden dragon head.
Matching stone tiles with eagle, dolphin, and wolf carvings on a wall panel.
Placing two golden dragon heads into a central stone box.
Retrieving a wolf emblem from the stone box.
Inserting various emblems into the main circular door lock.
Solving a pathfinding mini-game on the door to align helmet and beast icons.

solution_steps: Examine the carvings around the room (Dolphin 4, Eagle 2, etc.).
Rotate or swap the tiles on the wall panel to match the icons found on the pedestals.
Insert the three gathered emblems into the door slots.
Slide the beast heads (Left) and the knight helmets (Right) across the hexagonal grid to swap their positions.

final_action: The large stone door slides open after the hexagon puzzle is complete, revealing the way forward.
